exposure: more than one affected heart valve
poor NYHA functional class (more than II)
cohort: Pregnant women with rheumatic heart disease (RHD) who delivered at a tertiary care referral hospital between 2018 and 2023.
finding: Pregnancy in women with RHD is associated with adverse maternal cardiac, obstetrical, and neonatal outcomes, with more than one affected heart valve and a poor NYHA functional class (more than II) being strong predictors of adverse cardiac outcomes.
mod_finding: The cesarean delivery rate among women with RHD was 57.6%.
